items.title: Could GE Vernova (GEV) Gain From A $97 Million AI Infrastructure Rollout?

GE Vernova plans to deploy BrightAI's real time, predictive maintenance tools across its Power, Wind, and Electrification operations. The collaboration focuses on AI driven monitoring of turbines, grids, and related hardware to support asset uptime and maintenance planning.
